content: PH Data Privacy Act (RA 10173): NPC registration mandatory at 250+ employees, 1000+ sensitive-PI records, or risky/non-occasional processing; DPO designation required; breach notification to NPC and data subjects within 72 hours. NPC Circular 2023-04 (Guidelines on Consent): consent freely given, specific, informed, clear assent; no pre-ticked boxes; documented; easy withdrawal; layered notices; analytics/audience-measurement cookies may rely on legitimate interest instead of consent.
